Rain began at 6:31 pm, becoming heavy in wind-driven bursts as the rain would surge in gusts of strong wind from the east. We had tremendous frequent lightning and ground-shaking reverberating thunder. By 7:30 pm, the main storm had evolved to the southeast and rain had ended here. Another surge of storms came in from the southwest from an outflow boundary from the south from storms south of DC, giving a downpour with good lightning beginning at 8 and ending at 8:15 pm.
